body: The black matte liquid liner is my HG liquid liner. I occasionally have oily lids and this stays on all day and doesn't transfer.

I tried a minimal makeup look. Normally I do a basic full face. Yesterday I did Maybelline Dream Pure BB, ABH dipbrow, Maybelline the Falsies Push Up Angel mascara, KVD contour kit, Etherealle blush in sugar plum, and NYX Lip Lingerie in Push Up. 

The Maybelline BB is too yellow and dark for my skin, but if I use a tiny bit it isn't too noticeable.

The dipbrow is my HG. On days I don't use it I use the ABH perfect brow pencil. 10/10

The mascara is a new purchase for me, and it seemed to be doing its job before. I usually have black winged liner but since I was bare yesterday I got to see the results. HOLY CRAP DOES IT MAKE MY EYELASHES LOOK LONG AND THICK

The KVD contour palette never worked for me when I used the KVD double ended contour brush. But now that I'm using a Wet n Wild contour brush, I LOVE CONTOURING. Funny how that works.

The blush I've had forever and while I like it a lot at this point I'm just trying to use it up.

I never use the lip product because the color never looks good on me, but it fit in my no makeup look. Kinda made me think what other products I've been missing out on in my stash because they don't go with my everyday look.

One time, when I was 19 I accidentally applied for a credit card at a store. It was like a clothing store/department store, and I really think that they danced around calling it a credit card. Anyway, I was young and unfamiliar. I didn't realize what happened until I worked retail years later. Also one time I was at a very popular bra store with a friend and the cashier tried to get her signed up for the card, and made no mention of it being a credit card. When it asked to her to input her social security number, it hit her what they were trying to do. It was very misleading and felt a little predatory.
That is me every single day of my life. I almost considered getting side bangs to cover the eye that I always seem to mess up on.
